# THT Company (Trois Heures Trente)

> Hip-hop and contemporary dance company based in Carrières-sous-Poissy, France and Oslo, Norway.

Contact: compagnie.tht@gmail.com
Website: https://trois-heures-trente.com

## Works

- [FLEUR](https://trois-heures-trente.com/en/fleur): hip-hop solo by Ouili Nana, 50 minutes.
- [Cherche en Corps](https://trois-heures-trente.com/en/cherche-en-corps): duo by Ouili Nana and Raphaël Saint-Laurent, 50 minutes. Teaser: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TjewwAOC488
- [WINDOWS](https://trois-heures-trente.com/en/windows): 2025 creation choreographed by Ouili Nana, hip-hop trio.
